item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be relatively mild and humid over the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. It will be misty in the morning and at night in the latter part of this week. A northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China during the weekend, and will bring cooler and dry weather to the region early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 02/03 (Wednesday)
Wind: Northeast force 2 to 3, east force 3 to 4 later.
Weather: Mainly fine. Misty in the morning. Warm during the day.
Temp range: 18 - 24 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
